# Mandatory repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

Before proposing or changing anything in this repository, read and obey the root `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRATO_MAESTRO_IA.md`, and the relevant domain contract. For architecture principles, use `docs/ENGINEERING_CHARTER.md`; for branch rules, `docs/BRANCH_PROTECTION.md`; for delivery metrics, `docs/DORA_METRICS.md`.

These are acceptance requirements, not optional suggestions. Do not duplicate canonical logic or documentation, bypass tests or security controls, overwrite active work, or claim checks/deployments passed without evidence. If instructions conflict or required evidence is missing, stop and report the conflict instead of guessing. Use a branch and pull request; do not push manual changes directly to `main`.
